about: Package SKM1 (2026-11-20): skill worth by many methods vs today's price, Maps 0-20 skills. worth / price in budget points (cap-1 (3A + H) x m + S). Measurement only: nothing applied. tools/skm/summary.js

rules.flag: 3+ families and more than half of the families with an estimate 25%+ off the price (of max(price, 1)) the same way, on calibrated values
rules.circular: O-hedonic-*, O-measuredS, O-canon listed, not in the consensus

methods.name: H1 under a field

methods.name: H1 logit win rate
